meaning: Verify that selected native generators compose over the same checked source graph without losing domain distinctions, dependency coverage or producer-consumer behavior.
scope: Existing resolved TypeScript generator requests and their native leaf imports. Authored composition has its separately qualified verification; Python and Rust parity remain R10-R12. This definition does not alter domain relationships or add execution to identifier references.

boundary_foundation.input: Exact definition bytes, a process-registered checked graph and reconciled project plan with identical full certificate and source manifest. No caller-authored plan revival, filesystem fallback or provider callback.
boundary_foundation.identity: Retain whole and resolved plan identities, source capsule identity, every qualified root, every generator request and its selected source bindings, every module and its exact byte hash. Verify request and source-blob hashes before constructing the inventory.
boundary_foundation.ownership: Preserve complete module-to-request and module-to-qualified-selector incidence. A shared module can belong to several generator requests. Request identity, generator kind and domain metatype are distinct dimensions; overlapping ownership never erases a boundary between different kinds.
boundary_foundation.imports: Recheck the selected bounded static module surface and resolve each import against exact generated leaf paths or the already permitted node:crypto binding. Retain source import index, names, namespace, reexport and type-only flags, target hash and export surface. Classify generated type-only, generated runtime and native standard-library edges separately. Static runtime imports are candidates for behavior witnesses, not evidence that a call actually occurred.
boundary_foundation.closure: For every qualified source root independently traverse all generated native imports from its owned modules, retaining both type-only and runtime dependencies and each outgoing import edge. Cycles terminate by visited module identity. Compare the resulting exact closure with the public node artifact view. Account for shared modules even when they lack a source owner.
boundary_foundation.coverage: The denominator is all selected requests, modules, imports and qualified roots; retain zero-import modules and empty edge categories. Fail the whole construction on inconsistency or resource-limit exhaustion, never return a passing prefix. Limits are 8192 modules, 65536 import edges, 256 roots and 1048576 aggregate closure module/edge visits.
boundary_foundation.output: Deeply frozen private process-registered inventory with canonical content digest, complete category counts and behavior_status not_evaluable. No public verification status change, native execution or source capsule addition. Inventory is bound to captured source bytes, not a claim that an on-disk source tree remains current.

behavior_completion: Derive producer-consumer protocols and expected outcomes independently from checked domain contracts and selected bindings, not generated descriptors or expected answers supplied to the native runner.

Account for every applicable runtime boundary and its shared dependency closure; distinguish type-only/native-library coverage from behavior coverage. Explain inapplicable edges rather than silently omitting them.
Execute finite valid, invalid and foreign-value witnesses through actual generated producer and consumer modules using pinned native compilation and independent native surface observation.
Detect native-compiling semantic substitutions, omitted or redirected dependencies, duplicate/missing observations and partial-family coverage with negative controls.

Bind observations to exact selected source, generated and native artifacts, tool identities and complete case families; recheck custody and currentness through public source, snapshot, node, project and supported application entry points.

Aggregate fail, not_evaluable and pass without promoting inventory, hashes, compilation alone or isolated per-node tests into cross-generator behavior proof. Preserve full R08-R18 completion requirements.
effects: Definition and inventory are candidate product construction only. Do not execute production providers, endpoints, policy targets, recovery, publication, installation or deployment. No admission, default cutover or authority promotion.
claim_ceiling: The boundary foundation proves finite static dependency accounting over registered plans only. Full cross-generator behavior remains incomplete until the independent native witness and public currentness obligations are implemented and tested.
